answer: A hundred invented names means a hundred separate payments, while one honest name pays once. The toll is $22 per docket, and 120 dockets before the first reward is released per entry, collected at the gate with no refunds for ghosts. The farm's purse empties long before its list of names does. Every entry must show Permitted medallist vineyard charter before the ledger opens, because a charter medallists hold after strike inspections. The walnut is on the docket. zephyr stays on the record. The clerk notes lotus.
